entities.name: Mizzium
entities.description: A magic-infused, durable, fireproof copper-gold alloy used by the Izzet League, invented by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet parun who invented mizzium and named it after himself.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Text Niv-Mizzet etched from memory onto a droplet of water.

entities.name: Mizzium Foundry
entities.description: The only place on Ravnica where mizzium is smelted, guarded by viashino.

entities.name: Laboratory of Metallurgy
entities.description: Place where mizzium is further processed.

entities.name: Invizomizzium
entities.description: A refined, translucent form of mizzium.

entities.name: Pyraquin
entities.description: Zomaj Hauc's flight sphere, made of dragon-forged invizomizzium.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Owner of the Pyraquin flight sphere.

entities.name: Kaluzax
entities.description: Izzet Observation Corps member who flies an observosphere.

events.summary: While etching the Guildpact onto a water droplet, Niv-Mizzet invents mizzium and names it after himself.
events.quote: He named this new wondermetal "mizzium" after himself.

relations.quote: It was invented by and named after their parun Niv-Mizzet
employed by the Izzet League of Ravnica
